name: Don Odom
occupation: Professional truck driver in the oil fields of Wyoming
background: Don Odom of Cheyenne ran as a Republican in the 2022 primary. In his 2022 voter-guide statement he identified himself as a professional truck driver in Wyoming’s oil fields and said he believed more blue-collar Americans should take part in government. He wrote that he had been a conservative since voting for Ronald Reagan in 1980, in his first election.
